pre_slice_check._note: Before every implementation slice, the agent must answer these against the proposed work. Any YES blocks the slice until resolved or escalated to the architect.
questions: Does this task violate the OS surface contract?
Is the agent confusing Workbench with TerraForge Suite?
Is the agent proving a route instead of OS navigation?
Is the agent locking a required feature instead of finishing it?
Is the agent adding mock/fallback data?
Is the agent claiming local proof as production proof?
Is the agent touching files outside the slice?
pre_slice_check.on_conflict: If Brain doctrine conflicts with the proposed implementation, stop and report. Do not improvise architecture.

forbidden_confusions.rule: Suite home vs parcel-level Forge context — never interchangeable.
Tab is parcel-scoped Layer 4; Suite is Layer 3 launched from the Dock.
A 200 on a route is not a working product surface.
localhost evidence never closes a public-deployment gate.
A lock is honest posture, not completion. Required visible surfaces must be finished.
Docs do not substitute for what the browser shows.

facts: CompsForge data is real: ComparableSales holds 259,102 real Benton sales (PACS-converted, 1900-2026).
The original 36-row pool was a business-rule/data-window defect (SalesYear == taxYear only), not sample data.
CompsForge must use an assessor-credible lookback window: tax year N pools SalesYear N-3..N (2026 -> 2023-2026), SaleDate window fallback when SalesYear is null.
Qualification screen stays on the visible pool; rejected/disqualified sales are counted and disclosed, never silently included or hidden.
The UI must show the active comp window and the separated population counts (candidate / qualified / rejected / displayed).
compsforge_pool_doctrine.completion_rule: Do not call CompsForge complete until browser proof shows a meaningful Benton comp pool AND the active comp window, reached through OS Dock -> Forge -> CompsForge.
compsforge_pool_doctrine.resolution: TERRAFORGE-COMPS-LOOKBACK-RULE landed at aae00fda9: pool 36 -> 9,102 pool-eligible of 13,900 candidates, browser-proven 2026-06-09.
